title: Block: Price table

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: heading
fields.instructions: Optional section heading (h2), as on production. Screen readers also get it as the table caption.

fields.label: Sizes
fields.name: sizes
fields.instructions: Rows to show, like the groesse attribute of [coin_preise] on production (e.g. 20 Fuß and 20 Fuß High Cube). None ticked = every row. The sizes and prices come from Site Settings → Preise.

fields.label: Show note
fields.name: show_footnote
fields.instructions: «Stand: …» and the price note of Site Settings → Preise under the table (production: always).

description: Fields for the price table block (blocks/lists/price-table.php).
